method: Frozen channel-normalized19-shift grids, shared common sampling and same current tensor for B/C. Original A_native exact ready grids reused. B_native/other identical map-plan aliases reused instead of recalculated. All NEW scores independently verified with SciPy interpolation and a separate scalar Pearson expression<=1e-9.
metrics: AUROC before offset9/after maximum; same supported defined events for each comparison. Paired5000 video bootstrap seed42 and valid resamples, no decision threshold. Primary early-vs-latest is C_common/B_common plus interpolation control B_roundtrip; native/common difference is separately reported. Supplementary geometry-only rankings are unchanged native forwardIoU, negative native cost, and common cell count; no fitted combination or threshold. Clip strata include early/latest/current raw observations, the parent marked early/current only.
